info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights Bulls Say Bears Say API
Latest bull and bear cases for a given ticker symbol

params.name: symbols
params.description: Stock ticker symbol to query for bull/bear cases

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date. Default is 0

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of results to be returned. Limit 200

params.name: parameters[updated]
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

items.docs: Returns the latest bullish and bearish investment cases for a given stock ticker symbol. Bull cases present positive arguments for buying a stock, while bear cases present negative arguments against it.
